meta.title: Under One Roof
meta.author: Joe Guadagnino / Lupton Associates
meta.style: Lupton's own house system — the v7 look the playbook calls preferred. Dark green-charcoal radial ground with a 96px grid at 2.5% and ~60 drifting particles, split capability cards with an opaque left panel bleeding into footage, full-bleed beats captioned bottom-left, counters on a 640px rule with a 96px sage run, sage paint-swipes over every cut, badge end card with the Request a Quote button.
meta.note: This replaces BUILT, which was scrapped after four rejected cuts. Those all chased a black Apple-keynote look; this one goes back to the brand system the repo already documents and ships. Joe's recording is unchanged — the same fifteen phrases, re-spaced from 33 s to the house rhythm of ~40 s (v7 is 38.6 s).
meta.source: Joe Guadagnino product photography (2026-09-11), animated with Higgsfield seedance 2.5 image-to-video; his own voiceover (2026-09-11).

grid: 120 BPM under everything. The cold open, hook and four process beats sit on the beat grid; the turn lands on the score's hit at 22.8 s and the end card resolves at 34.4 s.

scenes.name: cold open
scenes.visual: Three highest-energy frames in rapid cuts — laser, arc, bend. The playbook's finding: leading with sparks puts the attention peak on second 0.

scenes.name: hook
scenes.visual: Laser clip at 50% behind a left-weighted scrim; sage dash, then 'Every part you buy / starts as a print.'
scenes.vo: Every part you buy starts as a print.

scenes.name: 01 / 04 cut
scenes.visual: Laser macro full-bleed, camera rushing in. Caption LASER CUTTING, headline 'Cut.', counter 01 / 04.

scenes.name: 02 / 04 formed
scenes.visual: Press brake, slow push with the plate hinging shut. Caption PRESS BRAKE FORMING, headline 'Formed.'

scenes.name: 03 / 04 welded
scenes.visual: MIG arc, camera arcing around the torch. Caption TIG, MIG AND SPOT, headline 'Welded.'

scenes.name: 04 / 04 finished
scenes.visual: The finished assembly turning under a raking key. Caption OFF THE LINE, headline 'Finished.'

scenes.name: the problem
scenes.visual: Split card — panel left, second-angle assembly right. Eyebrow THE USUAL WAY, three lines building, body line lands on 'when the holes don't line up.'
scenes.vo: Most buyers run that across four different shops. Four purchase orders, four people to call when the holes don't line up.

scenes.name: the turn
scenes.visual: Full-bleed statement over the arc at 42%. Eyebrow IN THE SAME SHOP, 'We do it / under one roof.' Lands on the score's hit.
scenes.vo: We do it under one roof.

scenes.name: the payoff
scenes.visual: Split card — eyebrow WHAT THAT BUYS YOU, the three 'one' lines building, body 'Quoted directly by the shop that runs the work.'
scenes.vo: One print, one project manager, one team that owns the fit.

scenes.name: the ask
scenes.visual: Statement on the ground: 'Send us / the print.' with the chip row PART DETAILS · MATERIAL · ANNUAL VOLUME · TIMING

scenes.name: end card
scenes.visual: Badge, LUPTON ASSOCIATES, the feasibility-estimate ask, 'Let's build it together.' in sage, Request a Quote button, LUPTONS.COM
scenes.vo: Let's build it together. Luptons dot com.

voiceover.status: FINAL — Joe Guadagnino's own recording (Webster_Golf_Club_7.m4a, 34.8 s, one continuous take). Raw and cleaned files kept at brand-kit/audio/joe_vo_*_2026-09-11.*
voiceover.processing: highpass 85 Hz, afftdn nr=10, alimiter; sliced only at Joe's own pauses (silencedetect -45 dB / 0.22 s), each phrase RMS-matched to -20 dB with 12 ms fades. BU6-BU8 run atempo=1.06.
wordingChanges: Joe said 'four different shops'; the on-screen label stays the condensed 'Four shops.'
Joe said 'one team that owns the fit'; the caption matches his voice.
voiceover.verified: Audio-only transcription over black confirms all fifteen phrases in order in the mastered 16:9.

cues.text: Every part you buy starts as a print.
Most buyers run that across four different shops.
four people to call when the holes don't line up.
We do it under one roof.
one team that owns the fit.

footage.source: Joe's five stills → Higgsfield seedance 2.5, mode omni_reference, start_image, 5 s each. His approved frame is frame one; the model supplies only the camera move.
footage.boomerang: uor_heroA_x.mp4 and uor_heroB_x.mp4 are forward-plus-reversed builds (10.08 s). The two capability cards run 8.4 s and 6.0 s, which is longer than a 5.04 s clip — without the extension the footage ran out and the card went black. Caught in the frame spot-check, not in the render log.

transitions: Sage paint-swipe over all ten major cuts: a BG0 slab leads by 2 frames, the sage slab follows, 13-frame sweep, skewed 9 degrees, 1.35x frame width so it covers. whoosh.wav at 0.34 under each.

music.bed: public/audio/uor_music.wav — original numpy score, 120 BPM, 40 s. Generator kept at brand-kit/music/score_uor_120bpm_40s.py. Sub pulse every beat, thinner through the problem section; 16th hats opening toward the turn; A-minor-pentatonic arp from 1 s, up an octave at the payoff; riser 21.3-22.8; big hit on the turn at 22.8; resolve at 34.4; fade from 38.2.
music.license: original — no third-party music, no credit required in the post

master: noise=alls=3:allf=t film grain, loudnorm to -14 LUFS (measured -14.5), peak -0.7 dBFS, faststart, Joe Guadagnino authorship metadata.
